name: RAMEN
description: Base model for digital editions, defining collections, content, entities and annotations and the relations between them.

classifiers.name: UUID
classifiers.description: A universally unique identifier represented as a string.

constraints.name: Valid UUID
constraints.description: Checks that the string has UUID format.

classifiers.name: Date
classifiers.description: A calendar date in RFC 3339 full-date format, such as 2026-10-21.

constraints.name: Valid date
constraints.description: Checks that the string is an RFC 3339 calendar date.
constraints.message: Value must be an RFC 3339 full-date.

classifiers.name: DateTime
classifiers.description: A date and time in RFC 3339 date-time format, including a UTC offset.

constraints.name: Valid date-time
constraints.description: Checks that the string is an RFC 3339 date and time.
constraints.message: Value must be an RFC 3339 date-time.

classifiers.name: URI
classifiers.description: An absolute Uniform Resource Identifier used to identify a resource.

constraints.name: Valid URI
constraints.description: Checks that the string is an absolute URI.
constraints.message: Value must be an absolute URI.

classifiers.name: Email
classifiers.description: An email address represented as a string.

constraints.name: Valid email
constraints.description: Checks that the string has email address format.
constraints.message: Value must be an email address.

classifiers.name: Selector
classifiers.description: A JSON object identifying a part of an annotated resource. RAMEN requires a non-empty type; the consuming tool interprets the remaining fields.

classifiers.name: Collection
classifiers.description: A group of resources in an edition, such as a letter or book. Collections can contain content and other collections.

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: The required, read-only unique identifier of this record.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The human-readable name of this record.

classifiers.name: Entity
classifiers.description: A person, place or other entity described in an edition. Annotations can refer to entities.

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: The required, read-only unique identifier of this record.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The human-readable name of this record.

classifiers.name: Content
classifiers.description: The text, image or other content of a resource. Content can belong to a collection and carry annotations.

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: The required, read-only unique identifier of this record.

classifiers.name: Annotation
classifiers.description: An annotation attached to a resource. Its type selects an annotation shape; shared properties apply to every shape on this node.

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: The required, read-only unique identifier of this record.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The name of the annotation shape that defines the properties and permitted relations of this annotation.

attributes.name: selector
attributes.description: Optionally identifies the annotated part of a resource, such as a text span or image region. The object must contain a non-empty type.

relations.name: PART_OF
relations.description: Places a collection within a collection.

relations.name: PART_OF
relations.description: Places a content item within a collection.

relations.name: HAS_ANNOTATION
relations.description: Attaches an annotation to a collection.

relations.name: HAS_ANNOTATION
relations.description: Attaches an annotation to a content item.

relations.name: HAS_ANNOTATION
relations.description: Attaches an annotation to an entity.

relations.name: HAS_ANNOTATION
relations.description: Attaches an annotation to an annotation.

relations.name: REFERS_TO
relations.description: Links an annotation to a collection that it refers to.

relations.name: REFERS_TO
relations.description: Links an annotation to a content item that it refers to.

relations.name: REFERS_TO
relations.description: Links an annotation to an entity that it refers to.
